Can one pip install steal your API keys?
On 21 Oct, LiteLLM 1.107.0 shipped a key and password stealer on PyPI for under 2 hours, and in the official Docker images too, even though its GitHub code was clean. Here is how it happened and what to check.
Full story: https://docs.litellm.ai/blog/security-incident-oct-21-2026
